findings: diagnosticsCaptured relies on nonempty Container header even if spawnSync docker logs fails; must track actual exit/error/capture completion, never complete true for failed log read.
Failed inspect fabricates running=false and oomKilled=false although unknown; use null/unknown and finite health enums.
Diagnostic write errors silently swallowed with no safe count/status or aggregate after close; preserve original failure and flag missing evidence truthfully.
Containment accepts task root and unrestricted relative child names, tighten exact owned run child; redaction should include decoded password/DB role/scoped schema and avoid raw SQL fields.
